app.name: Interpreter
mode.changed: The active task ended because settings changed.

seq.empty: Speak or enter text to begin.
settings.rememberKey: Remember personal key on this device
settings.deleteKeyConfirm: Delete the key and end the active task?
settings.keyDeleted: The key was deleted from this device.
settings.keyMemory: By default, keys are kept only for the current app run.
settings.keyStorageWarning: Browser storage is not an encrypted vault. Do not save keys on shared devices.

settings.sharedImport: Shared QR or masked key input
settings.hubKey: Register the key at the venue hub

settings.keyRestriction: Restrict your personal key to the Gemini API.

diagnostics.title: Connection diagnostics
diagnostics.scope: Results apply only to the selected provider, key source, and capability.
diagnostics.userStart: Press the button to start voice diagnostics.
notice.data: Text and audio are sent to the selected provider, even when history saving is off.
providers.geminiTerms: Review Gemini’s free-service data terms. Check the applicable terms before entering sensitive conversations.
notice.eligibility: Provider conditions must be checked for region, age, and personal or shared use. Eligibility has not been confirmed for everyone.
notice.accuracy: Interpretation may contain errors. Verify important details against the original.
notice.microphonePermission: Allow microphone access in browser settings to use speech. Text works without a microphone.
notice.wifi: Check the venue Wi-Fi and administrator instructions.
quota.title: Usage and limits
quota.project: Gemini limits apply per project. Changing keys does not reset limits.
quota.unknown: The key alone cannot establish billing status or remaining project quota.
quota.observedTime: Connection time observed on this device: {seconds} seconds
quota.resetUnknown: The exact reset time is unknown.
quota.noPaidSwitch: The app does not switch to paid use automatically.
records.memory: The current conversation is kept only in memory and disappears when the page closes.
records.clearConfirm: Clear all current originals and translations?
records.sharedEnded: Shared use ended; the key and current conversation were cleared.
pwa.installPrompt: Add to your home screen for easy access next time.
pwa.iosInstall: In Safari, open Share and select “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.browserInstall: Choose Install app or Add to Home Screen in your browser menu.
pwa.installUnavailable: The install button is unavailable here. You can continue in the browser.
pwa.updateAvailable: An update is available. Finish the active interpretation before updating.
pwa.nameLanguage: Changing the display language may not immediately change the installed app name.
pwa.offline: You can view existing content offline, but new interpretation needs an internet connection.
error.unknown: The task could not be completed. Check settings and retry.

error.IP_DENIED: Check that you are using the permitted venue network.

error.UNKNOWN_429: Requests are limited, but the cause and reset time are unknown. Automatic repetition has stopped.
error.UNAVAILABLE: The interpretation service is busy. Try again later.
error.MODEL_UNSUPPORTED: This model is unavailable. Run connection diagnostics.
error.SETTINGS_UNSUPPORTED: These settings are unsupported. Check settings.
error.SAFETY_BLOCKED: The provider declined this content. It will not be retried automatically.

pwa.closeOtherTabs: The app is open in another tab. Close the other tabs, then update.
sim.sourceAuto: The source language is detected automatically.
sim.seatAudio: Recognition quality may vary with seat noise and distance from speakers.
sim.personalKey: Prepare a personal key for the selected provider to interpret with your phone microphone.
sim.settingsChanged: Listening stopped because settings changed. Start with the new settings.
sim.manualResume: Press Start to resume listening after returning to the app.
sim.busy: Stop the current task before starting a test or voice preview.
sim.output.blocked: Press Turn sound on to allow playback. Captions continue.
sim.output.catching_up: Skipping queued speech to catch up with current audio.
sim.output.unavailable: Speech is unavailable. Read the captions.
sim.gap.input: Some microphone input was not sent.
sim.gap.audio: Queued speech was skipped. Captions are preserved.
sim.gap.reception: Some content may have been missed during the connection.
hub.noKeyOrMicrophone: Listening to the venue broadcast requires no microphone or API key.
hub.deviceSpeech: Venue speech reads final translated captions using device speech.
hub.recentNotice: Recent captions may appear when joining. Captions received before turning sound on are not read automatically.
hub.resumeSound: Sound is off after reconnecting. Turn sound on to hear new captions.
hub.broadcastError: Listening stopped due to a broadcast error. Check with venue staff.
hub.timeLimit: The broadcast ended at its time limit.
hub.accessDenied: You cannot join this room. Check venue instructions.
hub.languageRemoved: Listening stopped because the selected language is unavailable. Select a target language again.
hub.languageUnavailable: No supported broadcast language is available.
diagnostics.liveScope: The Live test is a short connection test for the selected provider, model, and key source. Voice tests and hub reception are separate results.
diagnostics.connectionOnly: A successful connection alone does not verify interpretation quality or audible output.
diagnostics.metricsPrivacy: Default measurements exclude keys, room codes, source text, translations, and original audio.
diagnostics.timingBoundary: Audio scheduling and device speech start events are not physical first sound. Measure actual listening latency separately.
diagnostics.policyBudget: Queue warnings and limits are app policies, not end-to-end latency guarantees.
diagnostics.delayedMs: Time with speech queue wait over 3 seconds (ms)
diagnostics.ttsFirstRequestMs: Time to first device speech request (ms)
diagnostics.ttsFirstStartMs: Time to first device speech start event (ms)
